Package com.hkust.marketplace.repositories

Class NotificationRepository

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.repositories.NotificationRepository
public class NotificationRepository extends Object
Database access for per-recipient notifications.

Implemented: create(Notification), findByRecipient(String), markAsRead(String) and notifyAllAdmins(String, String, String). Still planned:

  • countUnread(username) / markAllRead(username)
  • deleteForUser(username) is handled by the users FK ON DELETE CASCADE
Column names to map: isRead to Notification.isRead() and timestamp to Notification.getTimestamp().

  • Method Details

    • create

      public void create(Notification notification) throws SQLException
      Inserts one notification for its recipient using a new connection.

      A missing id and timestamp are filled in (UUID / now); the notification is stored with its current read flag.

      Parameters:
      notification - the notification to insert; a missing id and timestamp are set on the object
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when required text is blank or too long
      SQLException - when the insert fails (including a missing user foreign key)

    • create

      public void create(Connection connection, Notification notification) throws SQLException
      Persist using the caller's connection; never commit, roll back, or close it.

      Validation and id/timestamp filling match create(Notification).

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      notification - the notification to insert
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection or notification is null, or required text is blank/too long
      SQLException - when the insert fails

    • existsForUpdate

      public boolean existsForUpdate(Connection connection, String notificationId) throws SQLException
      Use a current read when checking a delivery ID after acquiring the deal lock.

      Reads with FOR UPDATE on the caller's connection; this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      notificationId - the notification ID
      Returns:
      true when a notification with that ID exists
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findByRecipient

      public List<Notification> findByRecipient(String username) throws SQLException
      Newest-first unread inbox for one recipient (uses idx_notifications_recipient).

      Equivalent to findByRecipient(username, false).

      Parameters:
      username - the recipient username
      Returns:
      the unread notifications, newest first; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when username is blank
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findByRecipient

      public List<Notification> findByRecipient(String username, boolean includeRead) throws SQLException
      Optionally include read history without changing existing unread-only callers.

      Uses a new connection. Results are ordered newest first, then by ID; with includeRead = false only rows with isRead = FALSE are returned.

      Parameters:
      username - the recipient username
      includeRead - true to include already read notifications
      Returns:
      matching notifications, newest first; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when username is blank
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • markAsRead

      public boolean markAsRead(String notificationId) throws SQLException
      Marks one notification as read, using a new connection.
      Parameters:
      notificationId - the notification to mark
      Returns:
      true when an unread notification with that id was changed
      Throws:

    • markAllAsRead

      public int markAllAsRead(String username) throws SQLException
      Scope a portal action to its authenticated recipient: marks all of one recipient's unread notifications as read.

      Uses a new connection. The username is used as supplied; the caller is expected to pass the authenticated name.

      Parameters:
      username - the recipient whose unread notifications are changed
      Returns:
      the number of notification rows updated
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the update fails

    • markAsRead

      public boolean markAsRead(String notificationId, String username) throws SQLException
      Marks one notification as read only when it belongs to the supplied recipient.

      Uses a new connection; already read notifications are not counted.

      Parameters:
      notificationId - the notification to mark
      username - the recipient that must own the notification
      Returns:
      true when exactly one unread row for that recipient was updated
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when either argument is blank
      SQLException - when the update fails

    • notifyAllAdmins

      public int notifyAllAdmins(String category, String title, String message) throws SQLException
      Creates the same notification for every active admin account (admin audit feed: listing submissions, account changes, reports).

      Uses a new connection; no explicit transaction is started, so the inserts are not committed together.

      Parameters:
      category - the notification category
      title - the notification title
      message - the notification message
      Returns:
      the number of active admins that received a notification
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when required text is blank or too long
      SQLException - when the admin lookup or an insert fails

    • notifyAllAdmins

      public int notifyAllAdmins(Connection conn, String category, String title, String message) throws SQLException
      Creates the same notification for every active admin using the caller's connection.

      Never commits, rolls back, or closes the connection; the caller's transaction boundary applies. Text limits and validation match create(Connection, Notification).

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      category - the notification category
      title - the notification title
      message - the notification message
      Returns:
      the number of active admins that received a notification
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when required text is blank or too long
      SQLException - when the admin lookup or an insert fails
